scope: Three visible duplicate destinations already present in the 161-location app.js roster; do not delete or rename any historical purchase identifiers.
acceptanceRules: Existing purchased IDs must remain in the underlying saved profile, even after display deduplication.
The single displayed destination must count as owned if any alias or canonical ID is purchased.
Equipped destinations using any historical ID must remain resolvable.
Buying a display destination must not deduct points if any member of its alias family is already owned.
Historical purchases of both IDs must remain readable; do not silently remove, refund or overwrite purchase history.
Never make new prices retroactively subtract earned points or XP.
Do not call migration complete until actual old-profile fixtures pass in an integrated browser test.
Do not merge or deploy until PR #1 shared app.js modifications have been reconciled and old user data backed up.
verification: The source location IDs and prices were read from world PR #2 app.js; alias policy has not been wired into app.js or localStorage.
